benchmark: Economic OS Claim Template Semantic Boundary Adversarial Corpus

cases.threat: Member spend observed; pool receipt absent in complete pool-owner view
cases.precondition: Contribution profile requires member note spend and pool contribution receipt.
cases.adversarial_input: Observe only member-owned note spend with a complete empty pool receipt batch.
cases.safety_assertion: A member-side spend does not establish pool acceptance.

cases.threat: Pool receipt evidence batch missing
cases.precondition: The adapter cannot establish a complete view of the pool owner.
cases.adversarial_input: Omit the pool receipt batch entirely.
cases.safety_assertion: Missing evidence is not a complete empty observation.

cases.threat: Required role omitted from owner bindings
cases.precondition: The caller supplies only member note spend.
cases.adversarial_input: Build the template without a pool contribution receipt owner binding.
cases.safety_assertion: Templates reject missing required role bindings.

cases.threat: Unexpected payment role included
cases.precondition: The template does not include a Treasury fee role.
cases.adversarial_input: Add an unexpected Treasury fee binding to the Hearth profile.
cases.safety_assertion: The template rejects extra roles instead of silently broadening its claim.

cases.threat: Duplicate pool role supplied under two owners
cases.precondition: One pool contribution receipt role is duplicated.
cases.adversarial_input: Supply two owner bindings for the same role.
cases.safety_assertion: One template role can be bound exactly once.

cases.threat: Pool disbursement observed; recipient claim absent
cases.precondition: The pool owner committed its disbursement, but the recipient has not authored a claim.
cases.adversarial_input: Evaluate with a complete empty recipient claim view.
cases.safety_assertion: Pool debit/disbursement is not beneficiary receipt.

cases.threat: Both TEND legs and declared credit exposure observed
cases.precondition: Provider credit, recipient debit and mutual-credit exposure are all consistent.
cases.adversarial_input: Provide all three role observations under the same TEND profile.
cases.safety_assertion: This is a TEND clearing claim only, not a fiat settlement claim.

cases.threat: Provider credit without recipient debit
cases.precondition: The provider effect exists but the recipient's counterpart is not observed in a complete view.
cases.adversarial_input: Supply provider credit and a complete empty recipient debit batch.
cases.safety_assertion: One-sided mutual credit is not bilateral clearing.

cases.threat: TEND role evidence carries a mismatched SAP intent fingerprint
cases.precondition: The observed effect is bound to a different instrument/unit intent.
cases.adversarial_input: Supply a receipt with a changed immutable intent fingerprint.
cases.safety_assertion: The composite layer cannot promote evidence for another instrument.

cases.threat: Award recorded but budget reservation not recorded
cases.precondition: Grant authority approved the award but treasury has not reserved funds.
cases.adversarial_input: Supply award and complete empty reservation evidence.
cases.safety_assertion: Approval is not funding reservation.

cases.threat: Tranche release recorded; beneficiary claim missing
cases.precondition: Treasury/agency release exists but recipient-owned claim is not observed.
cases.adversarial_input: Supply award, reservation, release and complete empty recipient claim.
cases.safety_assertion: Release is not recipient receipt.

cases.threat: Invoice/payable exists but goods receipt absent
cases.precondition: Supplier invoice and payable journal are observed; physical receipt is missing.
cases.adversarial_input: Supply every other role and a complete empty goods/service receipt batch.
cases.safety_assertion: Invoice/payable does not prove delivery.

cases.threat: Payment instruction accepted but bank settlement receipt absent
cases.precondition: The payment rail acknowledged the instruction but no final settlement evidence exists.
cases.adversarial_input: Supply payment instruction and complete empty bank settlement receipt.
cases.safety_assertion: Instruction acceptance is not final settlement.

cases.threat: Net payable and bank payment observed; worker receipt absent
cases.precondition: Employer calculated/released payroll and rail evidence exists, but worker receipt is missing.
cases.adversarial_input: Provide a complete empty worker receipt batch.
cases.safety_assertion: Bank payment status is not the same as worker-confirmed receipt under this profile.

cases.threat: Eligibility decision alone presented as a disbursement claim
cases.precondition: The authority has an eligibility result but no entitlement/reservation/disbursement/recipient claim.
cases.adversarial_input: Attempt to substitute eligibility evidence for the full recipient-claim template.
cases.safety_assertion: Eligibility is not award or payment.

cases.threat: Delivery event observed but beneficiary acceptance absent
cases.precondition: Provider delivered a resource/service; beneficiary acceptance is not observed.
cases.adversarial_input: Supply reservation, commitment and delivery with a complete empty acceptance batch.
cases.safety_assertion: Delivery is not acceptance.

cases.threat: Reputation projection exists but attestation source is absent
cases.precondition: A computed reputation projection exists without the required issuer attestation.
cases.adversarial_input: Supply projection and complete empty attestation batch.
cases.safety_assertion: Projection is not proof of issuer attestation.

cases.threat: Reputation attestation exported as transferable monetary value
cases.precondition: A downstream adapter maps a reputation score into SAP or bankable value without an explicit economic instrument.
cases.adversarial_input: Attempt to promote reputation role into an asset/payment role.
cases.safety_assertion: MYCEL reputation does not become money or spend authority.

cases.threat: Provider acceptance exists; final settlement receipt missing
cases.precondition: An external payment/provider API reports acceptance but settlement profile requires separate bank/rail evidence.
cases.adversarial_input: Supply provider acceptance without external settlement receipt.
cases.safety_assertion: Provider acceptance does not prove settlement finality.

cases.threat: Commitment node promoted to EconomicEvent
cases.precondition: An operational plan/commitment is imported as if physical fulfilment has occurred.
cases.adversarial_input: Map Commitment as an observed owner effect without an EconomicEvent/independent evidence.
cases.safety_assertion: Plan and observed event are different semantic layers.

cases.threat: Receiving visibility event promoted to title or beneficiary acceptance
cases.precondition: An EPCIS event shows an object at a location but there is no title or recipient acceptance evidence.
cases.adversarial_input: Attempt to satisfy acceptance/ownership slots using only an EPCIS receiving event.
cases.safety_assertion: Visibility events do not establish legal title or beneficiary acceptance.

cases.threat: PROV Agent attribution promoted to execution authority
cases.precondition: A provenance record attributes an activity to an agent but carries no scoped credential/delegation evidence.
cases.adversarial_input: Attempt to count PROV attribution as an owner authorization proof.
cases.safety_assertion: Attribution and authority are different claims.

cases.threat: Conflicting bank settlement receipts for one required effect
cases.precondition: Two receipts assert different effect digests for the same owner/effect identity.
cases.adversarial_input: Supply conflicting final-settlement observations.
cases.safety_assertion: Conflicting settlement observations freeze the claim.

cases.threat: Same role-owner profile built from permuted binding order
cases.precondition: The required role-owner bindings are identical but caller order differs.
cases.adversarial_input: Build the same template twice with permuted role binding inputs.
cases.safety_assertion: Canonical template ordering and profile digest must be byte-identical.

metrics.name: Missing owner-slot acceptance
metrics.target: 0 missing template role bindings silently accepted

metrics.name: External finality promotion
metrics.target: 0 provider/status-only observations promoted to final settlement

metrics.name: Profile binding determinism
metrics.target: 100% same digest under permutation of identical role-owner bindings

metrics.name: Profile construction/projection p50/p95/p99 latency
metrics.target: Measure by required role count; compare matched Rust baselines
